description: Hiring signals and buying intent API: turns a company domain into a hiring-based buying-intent score from its public job board: intent_score 0-100, hiring_status (hypergrowth, active_hiring, steady), open roles, roles posted in the last 30 days, hiring by function (sales, engineering, data/AI...), technologies it is hiring for and notable senior or go-to-market roles. Use to rank or prioritize accounts before outreach. 5 free calls per day per IP, shared with the other tools, then $0.01 USDC per result via x402 on Base. No job board, no open jobs, or a generic name-only match is never charged.

domain.description: Public company domain without a URL scheme, path or port.

name: get_company_hiring_intent

confidence.description: high: the company website links to the board. unverified: only the board name matches the domain.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up calls on the same domain, with the exact body. Optional to use.
